description: GPT-4, Claude, Bard, Llama and Gemini define the frontier race. The LLaMA leak spawns open-source explosion. Pause letter, White House pledges, Biden EO and Bletchley Summit build AI governance. OpenAI board fires and rehires Altman.

events.summary: Futurism revealed CNET had quietly published 77 personal-finance explainers since November 2022 under byline CNET Money Staff using an internal AI engine. Disclosure was minimal until readers noticed. On Jan 25 audit found errors in 41 of 77 stories including wildly wrong compound-interest math. Wikipedia later downgraded CNET reliability.
events.significance: First major AI-journalism credibility crisis.

events.title: Mixtral 8x7B SMoE plus €385M raise
events.summary: Mixtral 8x7B SMoE (46.7B total, 12.9B active per token) leaked Dec 8, officially released Dec 11 Apache 2.0, beating Llama 2 70B and GPT-3.5 at 6x faster inference. Same day Mistral announced €385M Series A at ~$2B valuation. Cemented Europe's open leader status alongside Llama.
events.significance: MoE goes open; proves sparse models win on efficiency.

events.title: New York Times sues OpenAI plus Microsoft
events.summary: NYT filed S.D.N.Y. suit alleging millions of articles used to train GPTs competing as reliable-info source, seeking billions plus destruction of infringing models. Cited failed licensing talks and verbatim reproductions. First major publisher suit, climax of 2023 training-data war, testing fair-use doctrine.
events.significance: Copyright fight moves from artists to publishers; licensing era begins.
